column1: # Readings the build script (scripts/build-word-lists.js) gets wrong, put right by hand.
# The script matches each listed word to a dictionary entry by its tones. Where the
# source writes a full tone that the everyday word reads neutral (the HSK source's
# shuōfǎ for 说法), or Taiwan's full tone (the TOCFL's gàosù for 告訴), it can pick a
# rarer entry that happens to have those tones: 说法 "to expound Buddhist teachings",
# 告诉 "to press charges". Found on 2026-10-14 by comparing each list word with the
# dictionary's other entries of the same letters; decided by Claude, from the
# entries' meanings. The word's Taiwan reading still comes from the dictionary.
# Columns: list, simplified, reading the script picks, reading meant, what the wrong entry means.
# The script stops if a line no longer matches anything, so a stale line is noticed.
# The app reads this file too (src/readingFixes.js): a device that added one of these
# words before the correction has it renamed to the reading meant at its next start.
# So never remove a line that has been published, even once the lists are right.
